SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY TO_DATE(GRP.REG_DTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') DESC) AS "LINE_NO" , GRP.TEAM_GRP_ID AS "TEAM_GRP_ID" , GRP.TEAM_GRPNM AS "TEAM_GRPNM" , TM1.TEAM_TOT AS "TEAM_TOT" -- , GRP.RGTR_ID AS "RGTR_ID" , USR.USERNM AS "USERNM" , GRP.REG_DTTM AS "REG_DTTM" , CASE WHEN TM1.TEAM_TOT = TM2.Y_TOT THEN 'Y' /* 구성완료 */ ELSE 'N' /* 임시저장 */ END AS "TEAM_GRP_CMPTNYN" , GRP.SBJCT_ID AS "SBJCT_ID" , CASE WHEN NVL(A1.CNT, 0) + NVL(A2.CNT, 0) + NVL(A3.CNT, 0) + NVL(A4.CNT, 0) + NVL(A5.CNT, 0) + NVL(A6.CNT, 0) = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS "USINGYN" /* 현재 사용여부 */ FROM TB_LMS_TEAM_GRP GRP /* 팀 전체 COUNT */ JOIN (SELECT GRPSUB1.TEAM_GRP_ID , COUNT(1) AS "TEAM_TOT" FROM TB_LMS_TEAM_GRP GRPSUB1 JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM TBSUB1 ON GRPSUB1.TEAM_GRP_ID = TBSUB1.TEAM_GRP_ID GROUP BY GRPSUB1.TEAM_GRP_ID) TM1 ON GRP.TEAM_GRP_ID = TM1.TEAM_GRP_ID /* 팀 저장완료 COUNT */ JOIN (SELECT GRPSUB2.TEAM_GRP_ID , COUNT(1) AS "Y_TOT" FROM TB_LMS_TEAM_GRP GRPSUB2 JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM TBSUB2 ON GRPSUB2.TEAM_GRP_ID = TBSUB2.TEAM_GRP_ID AND TBSUB2.TEAM_CPST_CMPTNYN = 'Y' GROUP BY GRPSUB2.TEAM_GRP_ID) TM2 ON GRP.TEAM_GRP_ID = TM2.TEAM_GRP_ID JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON GRP.RGTR_ID = USR.USER_ID /* 과제 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT TEAM_GRP_ID , COUNT(1) AS "CNT" FROM TB_LMS_ASMT WHERE DELYN = 'N' GROUP BY TEAM_GRP_ID) A1 ON GRP.TEAM_GRP_ID = A1.TEAM_GRP_ID /* 토론 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT TEAM_GRP_ID , COUNT(1) AS "CNT" FROM TB_LMS_DSCS WHERE DELYN = 'N' GROUP BY TEAM_GRP_ID) A2 ON GRP.TEAM_GRP_ID = A2.TEAM_GRP_ID /* 세미나 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUBGRP.TEAM_GRP_ID , COUNT(SMNR.TEAM_ID) AS "CNT" FROM TB_LMS_TEAM_GRP SUBGRP JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM SUBTEAM ON SUBGRP.TEAM_GRP_ID = SUBTEAM.TEAM_GRP_ID JOIN TB_LMS_SMNR_TEAM SMNR ON SUBTEAM.TEAM_ID = SMNR.TEAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_SMNR SMNR2 ON SMNR.SMNR_ID = SMNR2.SMNR_ID WHERE SMNR2.DELYN = 'N' GROUP BY SUBGRP.TEAM_GRP_ID) A3 ON GRP.TEAM_GRP_ID = A3.TEAM_GRP_ID /* 시험, 퀴즈 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUBGRP.TEAM_GRP_ID , COUNT(TRGTR.TEAM_ID) AS "CNT" FROM TB_LMS_TEAM_GRP SUBGRP JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM SUBTEAM ON SUBGRP.TEAM_GRP_ID = SUBTEAM.TEAM_GRP_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR TRGTR ON SUBTEAM.TEAM_ID = TRGTR.TEAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON TRGTR.EXAM_DTL_ID = DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID WHERE DTL.DELYN = 'N' GROUP BY SUBGRP.TEAM_GRP_ID) A4 ON GRP.TEAM_GRP_ID = A4.TEAM_GRP_ID /* 설문 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUBGRP.TEAM_GRP_ID , COUNT(TRGT.TEAM_ID) AS "CNT" FROM TB_LMS_TEAM_GRP SUBGRP JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM SUBTEAM ON SUBGRP.TEAM_GRP_ID = SUBTEAM.TEAM_GRP_ID JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY_TRGT TRGT ON SUBTEAM.TEAM_ID = TRGT.TEAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY SRVY ON TRGT.SRVY_ID = SRVY.SRVY_ID WHERE SRVY.DELYN = 'N' GROUP BY SUBGRP.TEAM_GRP_ID) A5 ON GRP.TEAM_GRP_ID = A5.TEAM_GRP_ID /* 게시판 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUBGRP.TEAM_GRP_ID , COUNT(BBS_ATCL.TEAM_GRP_ID) AS "CNT" FROM TB_LMS_TEAM_GRP SUBGRP JOIN TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL BBS_ATCL ON SUBGRP.TEAM_GRP_ID = BBS_ATCL.TEAM_GRP_ID WHERE BBS_ATCL.DELYN = 'N' GROUP BY SUBGRP.TEAM_GRP_ID) A6 ON GRP.TEAM_GRP_ID = A6.TEAM_GRP_ID WHERE GRP.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND GRP.DELYN = 'N'
AND GRP.TEAM_GRPNM LIKE '%' || #{teamGrpnm} || '%'

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY USR.USERNM ASC) AS "LINE_NO" , DEPT.DEPTNM AS "DEPTNM" , USR.STDNT_NO AS "STDNT_NO" , USR.USER_ID AS "USER_ID" , USR.USERNM AS "USERNM" , (SELECT CNTCT FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT WHERE CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN' AND USER_ID = USR.USER_ID) AS "MOBILE_NO" FROM TB_LMS_USER USR JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATND ON USR.USER_ID = ATND.USER_ID AND ATND.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND ATND.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' /* 수강 */ JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT DEPT ON USR.DEPT_ID = DEPT.DEPT_ID WHERE USR.USER_ID_STSCD = 'APRV_CMPTN' /* 상태코드 */
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : TeamGrpMgrDAO.listTeamGrpPaging 설명 : 팀 그룹 목록 페이징 */
/* SQL ID : TeamGrpMgrDAO.countTeamGrp 설명 : 팀 그룹 목록 카운트 */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM () Z
/* SQL ID : TeamGrpMgrDAO.listAtndlcUser 설명 : 수강생 목록 조회 */
/* SQL ID : TeamGrpMgrDAO.countAtndlcUser 설명 : 수강생 목록 카운트 */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM () Z

/* SQL ID : TeamGrpMgrDAO.listTeamAndMbr 설명 : 팀 및 팀원 목록 조회 */ SELECT GRP.TEAM_GRP_ID AS "TEAM_GRP_ID" , GRP.TEAM_GRPNM AS "TEAM_GRPNM" , TEAM.TEAM_ID AS "TEAM_ID" , TEAM.TEAMNM AS "TEAMNM" , TEAM.TEAM_BBS_USEYN AS "TEAM_BBS_USEYN" , MBR.USER_ID AS "USER_ID" , MBR.LDRYN AS "LDRYN" , USR.USERNM AS "USERNM" , USR.STDNT_NO AS "STDNT_NO" , DEPT.DEPTNM AS "DEPTNM" FROM TB_LMS_TEAM_GRP GRP JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM TEAM ON GRP.TEAM_GRP_ID = TEAM.TEAM_GRP_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR MBR ON TEAM.TEAM_ID = MBR.TEAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON MBR.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT DEPT ON USR.DEPT_ID = DEPT.DEPT_ID WHERE GRP.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND GRP.TEAM_GRP_ID = #{teamGrpId} ORDER BY TEAM.TEAM_ID DESC

/* SQL ID : TeamGrpMgrDAO.findLearnerTeamId 설명 : 학습자 팀 식별자(ID) 조회 및 검증 */ SELECT Z.TEAM_ID FROM ( SELECT TEAM.TEAM_ID FROM TB_LMS_TEAM TEAM JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR MBR ON TEAM.TEAM_ID = MBR.TEAM_ID WHERE TEAM.TEAM_GRP_ID = #{teamGrpId} AND MBR.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY TEAM.TEAM_ID ) Z WHERE ROWNUM = 1
/* SQL ID : TeamGrpMgrDAO.countUserInTeam 설명 : 특정 팀의 소속 여부 및 인원 확인 */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR WHERE TEAM_ID = #{teamId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}

/* SQL ID : TeamGrpMgrDAO.listTeamMembers 설명 : 팀원 목록 조회 */ SELECT MBR.TEAM_ID AS "teamId" , TEAM.TEAMNM AS "teamNm" , MBR.USER_ID AS "userId" , USR.USERNM AS "userNm" , USR.STDNT_NO AS "stdntNo" , DEPT.DEPTNM AS "deptNm" , MBR.LDRYN AS "leaderYn" , MBR.LDRYN AS "ldryn" , MBR.ROLE AS "role" FROM TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR MBR JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM TEAM ON MBR.TEAM_ID = TEAM.TEAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON MBR.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT DEPT ON USR.DEPT_ID = DEPT.DEPT_ID WHERE MBR.TEAM_ID = #{teamId} ORDER BY MBR.LDRYN DESC, USR.USERNM ASC, MBR.USER_ID ASC
mapper.update: /* SQL ID : TeamGrpMgrDAO.updateTeamGrpDelyn 설명 : 팀 그룹 삭제 */ UPDATE TB_LMS_TEAM_GRP SET DELYN = 'Y' , USEYN = 'N' WHERE TEAM_GRP_ID = #{teamGrpId}
mapper.delete: /* SQL ID : TeamGrpMgrDAO.deleteTeam 설명 : 팀 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_LMS_TEAM WHERE TEAM_GRP_ID = #{teamGrpId}

/* SQL ID : TeamGrpMgrDAO.deleteTeamMbr 설명 : 팀 멤버 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR WHERE TEAM_ID IN (SELECT TEAM.TEAM_ID FROM TB_LMS_TEAM_GRP GRP JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM TEAM ON GRP.TEAM_GRP_ID = TEAM.TEAM_GRP_ID WHERE GRP.TEAM_GRP_ID = #{teamGrpId})
